title: Airtight food storage
text: Airtight food storage. I purchased these on a prime day special.  They are big enough to hold a small box of cereal.  They washed up easily and dried quickly.  I did put some cereal in them - now is the wait to see if they are really airtight.  The lids were so easy to close I wonder about the "air tightness."  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
